title: M2M-VAEGAN-CNN
summary: An intrusion-detection system research codebase that generates synthetic network-flow records (with flags like SYN/ACK and Label/Attack/BENIGN columns) to address class imbalance in IDS datasets. It vendors a modified copy of the ctgan CLI tool under util/ctgan, but the actual synthesizer call has been rewritten to use SDV's CTGANSynthesizer from sdv.single_table.
